items.briefing:
A new MinterEllison report reveals that 71% of Australian organisations experienced a cyber incident in the past year, with AI increasingly being used by attackers to make threats more sophisticated and harder to detect. This is a significant rise and a clear signal that no sector — including education and training — is immune.

With AI-driven attacks on the rise, now is a good time to stay alert to unusual emails or login attempts, even if they look convincing. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected request for login credentials or sensitive information, verify it by calling the sender directly using a known number — don't reply to the message itself.

featured.title: Cyber incidents hit 71% of Australian organisations as AI reshapes the threat landscape, MinterEllison report
featured.quote: Record 71% of Australian organisations hit by cyber incidents as AI reshapes threats.
